cash_scope: Economic FCFF removes distributable economic value from EV. Actual operating cash is economic FCFF plus the five explicit reconciliation components. Cash interest is deducted in full separately. Other nonoperating cash includes investment sales/purchases, option/ESPP cash proceeds and other receipts/payments, excluding all separately listed items. Pair asset dispositions and dilution in their own ledgers. Positive signs add cash.
currency_scope: Retained EUR amount is a subset of net note proceeds still held in EUR at October19; current FX revalues that cash. Converted/spent proceeds are translated initially at issue FX, with explicit realized FX adjustment. Other currency cash translation is separate.
claim_scope: Every inherited nondebt claim is an explicit current valuation assumption, excluding per-deal new NCI. The current debt price fraction includes all current note claim value including accrued interest. Never use a cash payment to automatically release an unrelated claim. New deal-specific finance leases, litigation/tax or other noncommon obligations go in each deal other_claim_value_added, separate from inherited claims.
